content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media operator billing and network software and services; different customers and products from Autodesk's design tools."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Billing, customer care and payment software for pay-TV and telecom operators; no design or engineering overlap."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer engagement and knowledge software for customer service teams; not design, engineering or media software."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Application development, data platform and IT infrastructure software for IT teams; not design or engineering software."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"CAD and product lifecycle software sold by subscription to manufacturers and engineering firms, closely matching Autodesk's design and make business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, meetings and contact center communications for businesses; different products and customers from Autodesk."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience software for brand marketing and service teams; not design or engineering software."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Financial services software and outsourced fund administration for asset managers and banks; unrelated to design."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Cloud work management, content and records software for enterprises and government; not CAD, BIM or media creation tools."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes barcode printers, mobile computers and scanners sold largely as hardware to retail and logistics; different product and model."}]}
